grounding.states: Lima is the capital of Peru
grounding.from: Lima is the capital of Peru. Britannica says Lima is the capital of Peru

grounding.states: Cusco is not the current capital, though it was the Inca capital
grounding.from: Cusco is sometimes confused with the capital. It is the Inca capital in modern Peru. It is not the current national capital.

value.answer: Lima! It's been the capital since Peru became independent in 1821. Cusco gets mixed up with it sometimes since it was the old Inca capital, but Lima is the one.
